Subject: Renewal & expansion — pricing questions for mid-contract growth

Hi Sergio,

We're getting ready to scale a feature set that will drive about a 2.5x increase in tokens over the next 3 months. Our current contract (annual commit) is coming up for renewal in May but procurement asked if we can handle a mid-contract top-up and whether there are co-term / discount options if we annualize the added capacity now.

Key asks:
- Can you outline typical mid-contract top-up pricing and how discounts are applied if we annualize the uplift?
- What are the options for co-terming the top-up to our May renewal? Any pro-rata / blended-rate examples would help.
- Procurement will need a short amendment doc + a ballpark cost to move forward.

I've attached the current contract excerpt for reference. We're on fairly standard terms today. Would you be available for a quick 30-min call this week?

Thanks,
Asha
Head of Cloud Ops
Novum AI

Thanks, Sergio.

Procurement is asking for: 1) a mid-contract amendment that adds the uplift, 2) the cost to annualize the uplift now vs. co-term in May, and 3) any short-term bridge credit if we commit to the annualized number now.

We'd like a sketch of 2-3 pathways so we can evaluate quickly: immediate annualize, staged top-up with a voucher/credit, or co-term blended rate.

We can do Wednesday at 1pm PT for a call.

Asha

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-24T14:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: FW: Renewal & expansion — Novum AI (internal)

Sergio / Marissa — attached is the pricing_matrix_Q4_v2.xlsx (stubbed) and my notes. High-level options I recommend:

1) Immediate Annualize (best unit economics)
   - Add 300k units to existing commit and annualize today.
   - Discount: 15% off list for the uplift portion if customer commits for the remainder of the contract + next 12 months (effectively extends uplift to a 12-month annualized commitment).
   - Billing: add amortized monthly charge; final invoice aligns to May 15, 2027 co-term.

2) Staged Top-up + Voucher (low-friction)
   - Immediate top-up at current list with a voucher credit equal to 10% of uplift spend if customer annualizes at renewal.
   - Discount applied retroactively as voucher on next billing cycle after annualization.

3) Co-term Blended (simple co-term)
   - Add uplift today at a blended rate between current commit price and list price; no retroactive credit.
   - Discount: 8% blended discount for bridging to co-term on May 15.

I included sample pro-rata math in the sheet (example: add 300k units on 2026-11-24 => prorated charge for 173 days until May 15, 2027). Also added an optional one-time onboarding credit (up to $5k) for migrations.

Attachment: pricing_matrix_Q4_v2.xlsx (pricing matrix and sample invoices)

Karthik
Principal Pricing Analyst, Redwood Inference
